current.note: G1 (D80): kapı profili 288 kayıtlık (schemaVersion 3, R5.0d) tabana taşındı. Üç koruma uygulandı: (1) eşikler ölçülür, seçilmez - bu değerler legacy'nin bu tabandaki ölçülen precision/recall/ClassRecall:Hyphenation değerleri, asagi yuvarlanmadan (classBreakdown'daki 0.9659 yalnizca gösterim icin yuvarlanmisti - asil deger 170/176 = 0.9659090909090909, bkz. classRecallThresholds); (2) eski 160 kayitlik (schemaVersion 2) profil supersededProfiles[]'e tabaniyla arsivlendi; (3) D77 bu taban icinde aynen gecerli - esikler yalnizca yukari hareket eder. legacy.note: R5.0d re-measurement (was R4.0c's 12-record measurement: CorrectlyFixed=148, WronglyFixed=0, Deferred=12). Against the 288-record schemaVersion-3 ground truth, legacy now shows real wrong-corrections for the first time: odun-kesmek-glyph-0030 ('olın'->'olan', independently verified correct answer is 'John' - EvidenceOnly confidence, the lowest tier legacy has), odun-kesmek-mixed-0022 ('kol-1 ıı kta', legacy only fixes the inner 'ıı'->'ı' sub-span and leaves the surrounding hyphen/digit, so the occurrence reads 'kol-1 ı kta' - not 'koltukta'; this is the one D65 already flagged as legacy's own defect fixed correctly only by lattice's sibling occurrence), and odun-kesmek-auto-0174 ('zencileri-11in', hyphenation removes the dash but the OCR stage leaves the '11' digits untouched, producing 'zencileri11in'). G1 (D80, 2026-09-15): these measured values are now the gate's current threshold - the gate PASSES against this run.

hybrid.note: H3: hibrit motor icin ilk tam-kitap olcumu. Uc ayri kosu tek H3 oturumunda: (1) OcrMutationBaselineTests.FullBookFix_HybridEngineMutationProfileIsPinned (EpubFixService.Fix, docs/baselines/odun-kesmek.fix-hybrid.json) OCR mutation sayisini 129 verdi - 120 legacy + 9 lattice KAZANC, tek catisma (main-3.xhtml, 'ıı'->'ı') D83 geregi legacy'ye gitti; roadmap bolum 3.1'in D82/D83 tahminiyle birebir eslesiyor, DUR kosulu tetiklenmedi. (2) bu benchmark kosusu (QualityBenchmarkRunner, --ocr-engine hybrid test-data/odun-kesmek): kendi ocrPlanned/ocrApplied sayisi (138) farkli bir olcum hattidir - OCR asamasi burada hyphenation duzeltmeleri ZATEN uygulanmis bir stream uzerinde calisir; ayni sapma lattice icin de zaten var (pinned baseline plannedCount 10, bu dosyadaki lattice.ocrPlanned 19) - H3'un yeni bir bulgusu degil. (3) PerformanceBudgetTests.FullBookHybridFixStaysWithinBudgetOfLegacy: legacy 25.62s, hybrid 44.57s - hem 120s sabit kapiyi hem legacy+35s (D61) yumusak kapiyi ayni kosuda geciyor. Kapi SONUCU: FAIL - precision %98.85'ten %98.52'ye dustu (correctlyFixed 266, wronglyFixed 4, deferred 18). Dorduncu yanlis duzeltme yeni: odun-kesmek-garbage-0001 (':,ohbet' -> ':,sohbet', beklenen 'sohbet') - lattice'in kazandigi 'ohbet'->'sohbet' bolgesini yalnizca kismen duzeltmesinden kaynaklaniyor (baslangictaki ':,' garbage'i temizlemiyor). Diger uc yanlis (glyph-0030 'olın'->'olan', mixed-0022 'kol-1 ıı kta', auto-0174 'zencileri-11in') legacy'den miras - hibritte YENI degiller. Recall (%92.36) ve Hyphenation classRecallThreshold (%98.30) esiklerin uzerinde; yalnizca precision dustu. Esik DEGISTIRILMEDI (D77) - roadmap Risk kaydi #1'in tam olarak beklendigi gibi gerceklesmesi; dorduncu yanlisin H4'un elle inceleme kapsamina girmesi gerekiyor. ProtectedViolated 0, ProtectedChanged 0, UnexpectedTextChanges 0, NonTextChanges 0 (integrity temiz). Bkz. odun-kesmek.fix-hybrid.json ve roadmap H3 paragrafi.

lattice.note: R5.0d re-measurement (was R5.0a's 12-record measurement: CorrectlyFixed=149, WronglyFixed=1, Deferred=10, recall 93.12%, gate PASS). Against the 288-record ground truth the gate now FAILS just as sharply as it passed before: recall 58.33% < 92.5%, ClassRecall:Hyphenation 88.64% < 100% - precision stays just above the 98% floor (98.25%) but is now measured on 168 correct fixes instead of 1. This is the headline confirmation of D68/D69's premise: the old 12-record gate never actually exercised the lattice engine's recall gap (D64); it does now. The KAYIP-sourced ground truth (119 records where legacy fixes and lattice does not) explains almost all of the recall drop. G1 (D80, 2026-09-15): against the new 288-record threshold profile, lattice still fails on aggregate Recall and ClassRecall:Hyphenation - this is the expected, correct outcome (Faz 5's target distance), not a regression to fix by lowering the gate.

profile.note: R5.0a: gate is now class-breakdown aware and can run with either OCR engine (--ocr-engine legacy|lattice). Aggregate thresholds and classRecallThresholds were fit to the 160-record schemaVersion-2 ground truth (D64: that ground truth barely touched the OCR engines - 160 records with almost no intersection against the 120 production mutations). Superseded by G1/D80 on 2026-09-15 once the ground truth grew to 288 records (schemaVersion 3, R5.0d) and both engines were re-measured against it: both FAILED the 92.5%/98%/Hyphenation-100% thresholds below (legacy: recall 89.93%, ClassRecall:Hyphenation 96.59%; lattice: recall 58.33%, ClassRecall:Hyphenation 88.64%). Per D77/kural 4.5 this profile's thresholds cannot be lowered to make the new baseline pass - instead a new profile is measured from the new baseline (see current).
